subject.title: [Bug]: agent --json returns pre-hook assistant text instead of finalized before_message_write output

question: What should `agent --json` return when `before_message_write` rewrites or blocks the final CLI assistant message?
rationale: The central bug is clear, but blocked-hook behavior is a security boundary because preserving raw output can bypass plugin policy while suppressing or replacing output changes the public JSON contract.

options.title: Return only finalized hook output
options.body: For rewrites, return the post-hook assistant text; for blocks, suppress raw assistant text and use a clear blocked/silent result shape with regression coverage.

options.title: Preserve raw JSON output as a separate contract
options.body: Keep current raw payload behavior intentionally, document that `before_message_write` only governs persistence, and explain why downstream automation may see different text.

options.title: Defer to broader hook unification
options.body: Leave this issue open until the broader lifecycle-hook architecture chooses one result-finalization seam across CLI, Gateway, and channels.

recommendation.title: Return only finalized hook output
recommendation.body: For rewrites, return the post-hook assistant text; for blocks, suppress raw assistant text and use a clear blocked/silent result shape with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is on the CLI result contract, and the CLI runner history points most strongly to steipete as the area routing candidate.
